title: India's services sector just hit a 4-month high - while costs hit a 6-year low
sources: Free Press Journal - India Services PMI rises to four-month high of 55.8 in October
New Kerala (citing S&P Global data) - India's services growth accelerates, 55.8 in October, cost pressures ease
caption:
India's services sector just hit a 4-month high. And input costs just hit a 6-year low.

The HSBC India Services PMI, compiled by S&P Global, rose to 55.8 in October 2026, up from 55.2 in September - a four-month high, comfortably above the 50-mark that separates expansion from contraction. Domestic demand drove the growth, but input cost inflation for services firms eased to its lowest level in six years - faster growth without rising costs.

Growth that costs more to sustain eventually slows down. This growth got faster - and cheaper to run - at the same time.

Sources: Free Press Journal, New Kerala, citing S&P Global/HSBC data (2026)
